overview_description.description:
ProCart www.myprocart.com is an open competition marketplace
for the trade of office supplies and consumables that allows different
sellers to sell their products under their own names and brands.
•
ProCart allow buyers to negotiate prices with the seller depend on
their order size through quotation system or immediate purchase for
fast orders.
•
ProCart operating in the Egyptian Market applying the Egyptian tax
regulations and grants taxable invoice for all the purchases.
